modules.title: Road Safety
modules.summary: Safe practices that protect the driver and other road users.
modules.summaryHi: चालक और अन्य सड़क उपयोगकर्ताओं की सुरक्षा के लिए सुरक्षित ड्राइविंग अभ्यास।

sections.title: Safety First
points: Road safety is the first priority.
Wear proper footwear and the seat belt.
Do not use a mobile phone while driving.
Never drive after consuming alcohol.
Avoid dangerous overtaking, rash driving and unnecessary high beam use.
Use hazard lights when the vehicle is stopped because of a road emergency or is parked incorrectly, as described in the module.

sections.title: Safe Driving Habits
points: Stay alert and anticipate hazards.
Follow traffic rules and lane discipline.
Keep the vehicle under control and drive smoothly.

modules.title: Road Signs & Lane Discipline
modules.summary: Recognize signs and select the correct lane for safe movement.
modules.summaryHi: सड़क संकेत पहचानें और सुरक्षित संचालन के लिए सही लेन चुनें।

sections.title: Four Sign Groups
points: Prohibitory signs indicate restrictions.
Compulsory signs indicate actions that must be followed.
Cautionary signs warn about hazards.
Information signs provide useful road information.

sections.title: Lane Discipline
points: Follow lane markings and traffic rules.
On a six-lane expressway, lanes are designated for different speed/overtaking functions as explained in the training module.
Use the appropriate lane and avoid unnecessary lane changes.

modules.title: Emergency & Driver Safety
modules.summary: Respond safely to fire, roadside emergencies and vehicle risks.
modules.summaryHi: आग, सड़क आपातकाल और वाहन जोखिमों में सुरक्षित प्रतिक्रिया।

sections.title: Fire Extinguisher
points: Cut the plastic tie and pull the steel pin.
Pull the plastic out as described in the module.
Aim the nozzle at the fire and press the handle.
The pressure-gauge needle should be in the green band.
Check the extinguisher at the interval specified in the module (15 days).

sections.title: Emergency Parking
points: Use hazard lights during a road emergency.
Park in a safe location whenever possible.
For vehicle-specific emergency systems, follow the vehicle's approved operating instructions.

modules.title: Vehicle Familiarisation
modules.summary: Understand key controls, indicators and operating features.
modules.summaryHi: मुख्य नियंत्रण, संकेतक और संचालन सुविधाओं को समझें।

sections.title: Controls & Features
points: Understand Gear Shift Advisor and Power/Eco modes where fitted.
Know ABS, fog lamps, hazard switch, engine-compartment lamp, engine brake and other vehicle controls.
Understand lift-axle, override and send-help functions where fitted.

sections.title: DEF & Battery Cut-off
points: Use the approved plastic spout/procedure and Tata Genuine DEF as described in the module.
Do not leave the DEF cap open and refill before the red band.
Use battery cut-off for long/overnight parking or when required by the approved safety procedure.

modules.title: Fuel Economy & Driving Technique
modules.summary: Use driving technique, maintenance and tyre discipline to support fuel efficiency.
modules.summaryHi: ईंधन दक्षता के लिए ड्राइविंग तकनीक, रखरखाव और टायर अनुशासन अपनाएँ।

sections.title: Three Driver-Controlled Points
sections.titleHi: चालक के नियंत्रण वाले तीन बिंदु
points: Driving technique
Vehicle maintenance
Tyre pressure and wheel alignment

sections.title: 4 Golden Rules
points: Engine RPM
Vehicle speed
FE mode
Gear
Keep the engine RPM in the recommended green band and use the appropriate top gear when conditions permit.

sections.title: Long Stops
points: Switch off the engine during a long stop rather than unnecessary idling, following safe operating conditions.

modules.title: Vehicle Maintenance & Tyres
modules.summary: Daily/periodic checks that support reliability and fuel economy.
modules.summaryHi: विश्वसनीयता और ईंधन दक्षता के लिए दैनिक/आवधिक जांच।

sections.title: Maintenance Checks
points: Check the service indicator and follow the Operator Service Book.
If the specified red-band filter indication appears, change the filter; do not clean/reuse it where the module says replacement is required.
If water-in-fuel indication appears, remove the accumulated water as instructed.
Drain condensed water from air tanks weekly as described in the module.

sections.title: Tyres & Alignment
points: Maintain correct tyre pressure for load/application.
The module gives 120 PSI at rated-load examples; always follow the applicable tyre/vehicle specification.
Check tyre pressure at the interval given in the module (once in 15 days).
Keep equal pressure on rear inside/outside tyres where applicable and do not mix same-size nylon and radial tyres.
Follow the module's wheel-alignment/tyre-rotation intervals for the applicable axle configuration.

modules.title: BS6 Knowledge & Systems
modules.summary: Understand BS6 exhaust after-treatment, indicators and driver actions.
modules.summaryHi: BS6 एग्जॉस्ट आफ्टर-ट्रीटमेंट, संकेतक और चालक कार्रवाई समझें।

sections.title: BS6 Exhaust System
points: The module highlights changes in the engine exhaust system and instrument cluster compared with BS4 models.
The EGP includes DOC, DPF, DEF mixing chamber, SCR/ASC and clean exhaust exit.
DPF traps soot and regeneration uses exhaust heat to burn accumulated soot.

sections.title: Regeneration & HEST
points: Normal running can support soot burn-off through exhaust heat.
Active regeneration is automatically initiated as described in the module.
HEST indicates high exhaust temperature during regeneration; take appropriate safety precautions.
Regen Off should be used only in situations specified by the module, such as when hot exhaust components could create a hazard.
Stationary regeneration must be performed only in a safe parked location and according to the approved procedure.

sections.title: Driver Actions
points: For DPF indication, follow the module's highway/normal-driving or stationary-regeneration guidance, or contact an authorised workshop as applicable.
For SCR fault, contact an authorised workshop.
For low DEF, fill approved Tata Genuine DEF as specified.
For water-in-fuel indication, remove water as instructed.
Do not ignore escalating DPF/engine warnings; follow the authorised workshop procedure.

modules.title: Tata Samarth & Mobile App
modules.summary: Know the driver-support programmes and customer-care mobile app.
modules.summaryHi: चालक सहायता कार्यक्रमों और कस्टमर केयर मोबाइल ऐप को जानें।

sections.title: Tata Samarth
points: The source module presents Tata Samarth around accident, health, finance and education needs.
The programme section describes Surakshit, Swasthya, Sampatti and Shiksha/Saarthi programmes.
Use the current approved programme terms and eligibility at the time of deployment; dated benefits in the source should be revalidated before production release.

sections.title: CV Customer Care App
points: The training module instructs that the CV Customer Care App should be loaded on drivers' smartphones.
Use the current approved app version and official support channels for live deployment.
